'''Fel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Part of [[Eighty-second Armored]] unit, he was caught by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and imprisoned on [[A-77 (prison)|A-77]]. He was eventually rescued by [[Havoc Squad]] during th [[A-77 operation]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Major Fel appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Trooper class mission only if the player makes the Light Side choice on A-77. In the Dark Side option player saves [[Ava Jaxo]] at the cost of 314 prisoners who all perish, including Fel.
